specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished concept sheet for a desktop 2D strategy game's BUILDING ART, called ForgeFront. Wide landscape image, 3 columns by 2 rows, six clearly separated large illustrations on a uniform muted light gray-sage background. Match a restrained tactical command-map aesthetic: slate concrete, gunmetal roofs, olive canvas, weathered khaki and tiny muted teal faction accents. Not cute, not cartoon toy proportions, not pixel art, not photoreal architectural rendering. Refined painted 2D game sprites with crisp silhouettes and restrained surface detail. Fixed orthographic high overhead camera about 70 degrees elevation; rooftops dominant, only a little front wall visible. Same camera direction and short soft lighting for every object. No dramatic long shadows, no thick floating diorama platforms, no people, weapons, vehicles, combat, HUD or surrounding map. Large clear spaces between assets.
Six numbered cells, with clean readable Simplified Chinese captions underneath:
01 总部: compact two-storey reinforced command building, strong broad flat central roof, one small communication mast and roof antenna, subtle teal stripe, clearly the primary building.
02 兵营: low paired long-roof dormitory blocks around a small open assembly yard; compact footprint and simple recognizable roof silhouette, no excessive props.
03 装备工坊: practical sawtooth-roof industrial workshop, two short exhaust stacks, broad loading door and a compact exterior utility annex, charcoal and olive palette.
04 金矿: compact mine pithead timber/steel support over a dark shaft opening, stone retaining walls, a small ore hopper with muted ochre ore; avoid cartoon gold coins.
05 堡垒: small squat reinforced concrete outpost, low polygonal roof and four compact corner buttresses, modest utility doors; no mounted weapons.
06 堡垒·备选: alternative low circular concrete outpost with flat cap and angular entrance wing, visibly distinct silhouette, same building scale.
Keep the footprint of all six broadly comparable for placement on irregular provinces. Each illustration reads as a game object at 48–80 pixels, emphasize the major roof shape rather than tiny clutter. Top left title 'B 风格 · 建筑参考'; small subtitle '冷灰 / 军绿 / 固定俯视角'. This is a visual reference sheet, not a playable screenshot. Avoid adding any other labels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished environment asset concept sheet for a desktop 2D strategic province-map game, ForgeFront, matching a restrained tactical command-map aesthetic. Wide landscape image with a clean 3 by 3 grid of nine separate terrain-decoration illustrations on a uniform muted light gray-sage background. Cool gray rock, dusty sage grass, dark muted olive trees, desaturated blue-gray water. Refined painted 2D sprite style with readable silhouettes and moderate natural detail. Not pixel art, not neon, not cartoon toys, not photoreal photography. Fixed orthographic high overhead view around 70 degrees elevation, consistent direction across every illustration, roofs absent; short soft shadows, no black cast shadows. Objects taper into sparse transparent-looking ground edges but use the specified solid sheet background. No thick square diorama bases or floating cutaway cubes, no grid tiles, no buildings, no people, no HUD, no game mechanics.
Nine cells with readable Simplified Chinese captions underneath:
01 独立山峰: a compact gray rocky peak with clear top-facing ridges, restrained height and small footprint.
02 低矮山脊: an elongated low rocky ridge of three connected humps, usable along a province interior, gentle tapering ends.
03 连绵山脉: a connected irregular cluster of 4–5 gray peaks with broad pale saddles, more complex silhouette but not a towering impassable wall.
04 缓坡丘陵: a softly rolling group of low grass-covered hills with subtle contour and minimal shading.
05 碎石与岩块: a reusable grouping of 5–7 varied rocks, clearly separated with a few gravel specks, natural uneven spacing.
06 针叶林: a sparse cluster of 6 conifers with identifiable individual crowns and visible gaps, desaturated dark olive.
07 阔叶林: a sparse cluster of 5 rounded broadleaf crowns with varied size, low contrast, distinct from the conifers.
08 岩石海岸: a short irregular coastal edge segment with low gray cliffs, narrow sandy transition and calm desaturated blue water, no tall blocker wall.
09 河岸与浅滩: a shallow curving narrow stream segment with gravel banks and a low sandbar, calm water, soft edges.
No province boundaries baked into any asset. Preserve visual breathing room so decoration can sit behind thin map borders, supply lines and army tokens without competing. Show each cell at a comparable readable scale and leave generous margins. Top left title 'B 风格 · 地图装饰参考'; subtitle '山地 / 林地 / 岸线'. No other text.
